name: John the Baptist
title: The Cry in the Wilderness
summary: John the Baptist was the last prophet before the Messiah and the forerunner of Jesus. He was miraculously born to the priest Zechariah and his elderly wife Elizabeth. He lived an ascetic life in the desert, preaching repentance and baptism for the forgiveness of sins. He pointed to Jesus as 'the Lamb of God' and was executed by Herod Antipas.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's Message to Zechariah
keyEvents.description: The angel Gabriel announced to the priest Zechariah that his elderly wife Elizabeth would bear a son who would prepare the way for the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Preaching in the Desert
keyEvents.description: John emerged in the desert and preached a baptism of repentance. People came from all over Judea and Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Baptism of Jesus
keyEvents.description: John baptized Jesus in the Jordan River. The heavens opened, the Spirit descended like a dove, and a voice said: 'This is my Son.'

keyEvents.title: Lamb of God
keyEvents.description: John pointed to Jesus and said: 'Behold, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!' and 'He must increase, but I must decrease.'

keyEvents.title: The Martyrdom
keyEvents.description: John was imprisoned by Herod because he criticized the king's marriage, and was beheaded at the request of Herodias' daughter.
